findings.title: §4-B cross-wave integration test (G-CORE-3 × G-CORE-4 SubgraphSpec live-eval + IVM CanonicalViews subscription invalidation) missing at HEAD AND missing named-deferred destination
findings.body: R2-test-landscape.md §4-B specifies: 'Alice grants Bob a UCAN scoped to a SubgraphSpec. Alice writes a new Recipe matching the spec; the IVM CanonicalViews subscription correctly emits a ChangeEvent that the resolver consumer hears (D-4M-R5 — live-per-request semantics; resolver reuses CanonicalViews subscription). Bob's next request returns the new Recipe (sub-graph SHAPES that evolve, not frozen snapshots).' R3-W5 partition named this as `crates/benten-engine/tests/cross_wave_3_x_4_subgraphspec_live_eval_ivm_canonical_views.rs`. §3.5n ground-truth-verified: (a) the named file does NOT exist at HEAD `a0b75637` (`find crates/benten-engine/tests -name 'cross_wave_*' = empty`); (b) no other test file at HEAD exercises the SubgraphSpec × CanonicalViews subscription integration (`grep -l 'subgraph_spec.*subscribe|D-4M-R5|live.per.request|resolver.*subscription' crates/*/tests/*.rs = empty`); (c) `tf5_431_ivm_inner_kernel_read_5arm_byte_equivalence.rs` exercises 5-arm byte-equivalence between SubgraphSpec-routed walk + legacy walk (a DIFFERENT property; not the live-eval invalidation semantic); (d) NO named-deferred destination found for §4-B in `docs/V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE-DEFERRED.md` (rows D-1..D-22 all distinct; no row for SubgraphSpec live-eval) OR `docs/future/phase-4-backlog.md` (no §4.x row for cross-wave 3×4). This is a HARD-RULE-12 violation: the §4-B disposition is implicitly 'defer' but neither (b) BELONGS-NAMED-NOW nor (c) DISAGREE-WITH-EXPLANATION applies — there is no named destination row. The D-4M-R5 ratification (live-per-request semantics; IVM-cache-invalidation seam) is in RATIFIED-sharing-and-confidentiality-2026-05-21.md but the test coverage for the seam-as-shipped has no anchor at HEAD.
findings.proposed_fix_shape: (a) ADD a row to `docs/V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE-DEFERRED.md` naming this as a G-COMP-1 destination (the SubgraphSpec live-eval semantics couple to the engine resolver consumer + CanonicalViews subscription seam — both signature-frozen at v1-beta but consumer wiring deferred), OR (b) add a row to `docs/future/phase-4-backlog.md §4.x` carrying this as a Phase-4-Meta-Composing test pin, OR (c) write the test file now (the R5 G-CORE-3w + G-CORE-4 substrates are merged so the test substrate is available). Orchestrator pick most-likely (a)+(b) — destination row in DEFERRED.md naming the file path that the test would land at G-COMP-1, plus a phase-4-backlog row referencing same. ~30-60 LOC doc edit + cite-drift sweep.

Adversarial: install plugin P with manifest scope {A,B}; grant P a UCAN scoping {B,C}; P's effective scope = {B} (intersection); requests for A or C return OutOfScope.' R3-W5 partition named this as `crates/benten-engine/tests/cross_wave_3_x_7_manifest_envelope_intersects_ucan_scope.rs`. §3.5n ground-truth-verified: (a) file does NOT exist at HEAD; (b) no test exercises the joint manifest-envelope ∩ UCAN-SubgraphSpec scope intersection semantic; (c) tf3b_chain_validator_narrowing.rs covers chain-validator narrowing in isolation; tf7_g_core_7_install_lifecycle_hardening.rs covers install-time manifest semantics in isolation; the COMPOSITION pin (both must admit; intersection semantics) is the §4-C gap; (d) NO named-deferred destination found in V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE-DEFERRED.md or phase-4-backlog.md.
findings.proposed_fix_shape: Same shape as r4b-l1-1: ADD named-deferred destination row to V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE-DEFERRED.md OR phase-4-backlog.md naming the file path + G-COMP-1 consumer wiring. Alternative: write the test file now (G-CORE-3b chain_validator + G-CORE-7 install path BOTH merged; test substrate available). Orchestrator pick (a) deferral row given the v1-beta consumption-deferred posture for cross-wave consumers.
